ProviderHealthEntry.description: The outcome of the check of one provider.

detail.description: The failure detail, a message for people that is not stable; null when the check passed.
detail.title: Detail

elapsed_seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds the check took, rounded to hundredths.
elapsed_seconds.title: Elapsed Seconds

library.description: The library behind the provider and its installed version; null when the provider has none.

probe.description: What the check requests; a message for people, not stable.
probe.title: Probe

provider_id.description: The provider's stable identity, as `--provider` names it.
provider_id.title: Provider Id

verdict.description: ok: every request answered in the shape the adapter reads. unreachable, rate_limited, unexpected_response and no_data: the provider failed in that way. not_configured: SEC access is not set up, so the check could not run. failed: an unexpected error inside the check.
verdict.title: Verdict

ProviderLibrary.description: The installed library the application reaches a provider through.

name.description: The library's distribution name, as installed.
name.title: Name

version.description: The installed version. The library is pinned, so an unchanged version means a new failure came from the provider's side.
version.title: Version
